opportunities.title: Autumn 2026 Round of Funding Opportunities

amount.raw: Up to £40,000 for organisations, up to £6,000 for individuals, up to £6,000 for organisations for publications, up to £5,000 for digitisation, up to £3,000 for events, up to £25,000 for conservation

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals and organisations undertaking research in British art, visual culture and architectural history.
opportunities.summary: Grant applications for our Autumn 2026 round of funding are open now and will close Monday 14 September at 11:59pm BST. This round will be the first since we announced a new structure for our funding earlier this year and we are really looking forward to reading more about the inspiring research projects in the field of British art, visual culture and architectural history through the applications we receive.
